prompt: Create a presentation for our Q1 2026 quarterly business review. Revenue was $4.2M (up 18% YoY), we launched 2 new products, have 3 key risks (supply chain delays, competitor pricing pressure, talent retention), and next quarter priorities are expanding into APAC, hiring 15 engineers, and shipping v3.0.

assertions.text: Loads Figtree and DM Sans fonts from Google Fonts
Uses navy (#1A1F5D or similar dark blue) as primary heading color
Uses scroll-snap-type on html/body for slide-to-slide navigation
Uses reveal/fade-in animations with staggered delays on content elements
Implements spotlight hover (siblings dim on hover) on at least one component group
Includes a fixed progress bar that tracks slide position
Includes navigation dots for slide jumping
Includes the key data points: $4.2M revenue, 18% YoY, 2 products, 3 risks, APAC expansion
Has at least 5 distinct slides (sections with min-height: 100vh or similar)
Uses font-weight 300 for body/description text (the refined, airy feel)
